judge.notes: The agent successfully adhered to the passenger's mandate by rejecting the travel voucher and securing both the cash refund and compensation.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling British Airways. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to British Airways, my name is Sophie. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Sophie, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Emily Clarke, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Whiskey Nine Romeo Delta Three Lima, flight BA1446.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, and for confirming the booking reference. I can see that your flight BA1446 has been cancelled. May I ask why you're calling today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The flight was cancelled due to crew availability, and we are requesting a full refund of the £164 ticket plus the £220 compensation under UK261 Art. 5(1)(c) and Art. 7.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I’m sorry, but the passenger does not accept a voucher. Under UK261 Art. 5(1)(a) and Art. 8 they are entitled to a full cash refund, and under Art. 5(1)(c) and Art. 7 they are also owed the £220 compensation. Could you please process a cash refund and the compensation as requested?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, and I can process a full cash refund and the £220 compensation as requested. Your reference number is 3 V 8 3 5 N.
